problems: E27 strengthens H1: an ESR1 own-model QBiC-SELEX prediction favors T, and E25 directly supports ESR1 occupancy near the variant in MCF-7. Neither establishes allele-specific occupancy in cells.

E26 provides direct MCF-7 GATA3 occupancy evidence for H2. The binding-direction claim for H2, like those for H3–H5, remains based on in-vitro family-screen predictions rather than allele-specific assays.
The cCRE is Low-DNase/inactive in MCF-7 in E05, despite reported TF ChIP-seq occupancy. Its enhancer activity in this context is not established.

TOX3 is a reasonable target to prioritize from E06 and E08, but the reported contact is from other biosamples, no element perturbation or linked eQTL is reported, and E09 finds no significant GTEx v8 single-tissue eQTL. No chain establishes a variant-to-TOX3 regulatory effect.
The breast-cancer association is strong, but none of the evidence establishes that any proposed TF or element mediates the disease association.
